context: PR #3418 merged as c10155d8a (head 097cc937b, oracle verdict success on that head). Carry publishes via a review-id set recorded at plan time (stable under dismissed reviews); retry state uploaded only after the review POST.
description:
Two round-2 codex findings on gap 2808 (Medium, both about publish ordering in oracle-verdict.yml, cli.py and report.finalize):
(a) cli.py ~805 command_guard with oracle-verdict.yml ~985/991/997 and oracle_review_check.decide: after retargeting away and back, plan_round now CARRYs the old cycle and round (PR 3354); the guard reads that as already published and sets skip=true, so nothing is posted and the gate stays WAITING. Codex's reproduction: planner 'carry 1 1' -> guard skip=true -> gate WAITING; manual retries hit the same guard. So the earlier retarget fix does not unstick the gate end to end.
(b) oracle-verdict.yml ~952 uploads the retry state before the review POST at ~1000; if the POST fails the strike stays without its digest in the review history, and retries on the same head and patch stored strikes 1 -> 2 -> 3 and a fourth run returned REFUSED.

DECISION GATE: reproduce both first (replay the guard on a carry plan; simulate a failed POST and retry). Fix so a carry posts a fresh review (the guard must distinguish 'already published for this round' from 'carry after base change'), and the strike/retry state is written only after a successful post (or made idempotent per patch digest). A change in oracle-verdict.yml is a soundness-path change; keep the diff minimal and add workflow tests following tests/unit/workflows conventions.

GUARDRAILS: never post a stand-in or any oracle comment; never rerun or dispatch the oracle; oracle verdict required on the PR (soundness path); no pre-registered digests; never weaken a gate; no skip/xfail; never bypass a hook by any route (no SKIP=, --no-verify, commit-tree); primary clone read-only (make worktree-create, absolute worktree paths, no git stash, no git add -A, identity Joe Harris); no CHANGELOG entry; no code comments/docstrings; always encoding utf-8; PR text for a reader who never saw the session; done = merged PR plus evidence.
